mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STAY_ID, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(STATUS_CD, 'APPROVE') = 'APPROVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS APPROVE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'HOLD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HOLD_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD IN ('CLOSED', 'DELETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CLOSED_CNT, MIN(PRICE_PER_NIGHT) AS MIN_PRICE FROM TB_STAY_ROOM GROUP BY STAY_ID ) R ON R.STAY_ID = S.STAY_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT S.STAY_ID AS stayId, S.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, S.NAME AS name, S.PHONE AS phone, S.ADDR AS addr, S.ADDR_DETAIL AS addrDetail, S.REGION AS region, S.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, S.APPROVE_DATE AS approveDate, NVL(R.ROOM_CNT, 0) AS roomCount, NVL(R.APPROVE_CNT, 0) AS approveRoomCount, NVL(R.HOLD_CNT, 0) AS holdRoomCount, NVL(R.CLOSED_CNT, 0) AS closedRoomCount, NVL(R.MIN_PRICE, 0) AS minPrice, (SELECT F.FILE_URL FROM TB_FILE F WHERE F.REF_TYPE = 'STAY' AND F.REF_ID = S.STAY_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS thumbPath FROM TB_STAY S LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = S.BIZ_NO
WHERE 1 = 1
AND S.STATUS_CD IN ('ACTIVE', 'NORMAL')
AND S.STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}
AND ( UPPER(NVL(S.NAME, ' ')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(B.BIZ_NAME, ' ')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(S.ADDR, ' ')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY S.STAY_ID DESC
SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD IN ('ACTIVE', 'NORMAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "ACTIVE", COUNT(*) AS "ALL" FROM TB_STAY

SELECT S.STAY_ID AS stayId, S.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, S.NAME AS name, S.PHONE AS phone, S.ADDR AS addr, S.ADDR_DETAIL AS addrDetail, S.REGION AS region, S.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, S.APPROVE_DATE AS approveDate, S.CHECK_IN AS checkIn, S.CHECK_OUT AS checkOut, NVL(R.ROOM_CNT, 0) AS roomCount, NVL(R.APPROVE_CNT, 0) AS approveRoomCount, NVL(R.HOLD_CNT, 0) AS holdRoomCount, NVL(R.CLOSED_CNT, 0) AS closedRoomCount, NVL(R.MIN_PRICE, 0) AS minPrice, (SELECT F.FILE_URL FROM TB_FILE F WHERE F.REF_TYPE = 'STAY' AND F.REF_ID = S.STAY_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS thumbPath FROM TB_STAY S LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = S.BIZ_NO
WHERE S.STAY_ID = #{stayId}
SELECT ROOM_ID, STAY_ID, NAME, PRICE_PER_NIGHT, CAPACITY, PET_LIMIT, STATUS_CD FROM TB_STAY_ROOM WHERE STAY_ID = #{stayId} ORDER BY ROOM_ID
